name: kraken-host
description: Shows the carousel on the NZXT Kraken Elite LCD without NZXT CAM. Display only: it never changes pump, fan or lighting settings.

scripts.build-exe: electron-packager . KrakenHost --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=dist --overwrite --icon=assets/icon.ico --ignore="^/(dist|sensors|scripts|tools)" --win32metadata.CompanyName="Kraken Host" --win32metadata.FileDescription="Kraken Host — carousel on the Kraken LCD"
